annotation.kind: faithful reconstruction of Theorem 4.1 and its limited-precision stochastic recursive-summation model

assumptions: The exact sum is nonzero, so the relative error and summation condition number are defined.
The output precision p and random-bit count r are positive.
Each recursive addition has a relative SR error delta bounded by u_p and a nonnegative multiplicative factor.
Each deterministic p+r-bit truncation error beta is linked to the actual pre-rounding value and bounded by u_(p+r).
The finite conditional-mean identity E(delta_k | prior errors) = beta_k holds in test-function form.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P17 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P17 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p17_t2_recursive_sum_bias_condition_bound {m : Nat} {Omega : Type} [Fintype Omega] (run : P17LimitedPrecisionRecursiveSumRun m Omega) (hsum : p17ExactSum run.a != 0) : abs (p17ExpectedRecursiveSum run - p17ExactSum run.a) / abs (p17ExactSum run.a) <= p17SummationCondition run.a * p17Gamma m (p17UnitRoundoff (run.p + run.r))
formal_statement.plain_language: The expected bias of an m-addition recursive sum computed with limited-precision stochastic rounding SR_(p,r) is at most its summation condition number times gamma_m(u_(p+r)).

informal_proof: Expand the generated recursive sum into equation (4.4)'s input coefficients. Use the conditional-mean identity, the p+r-bit truncation-error bound, and nonnegative SR factors to derive the expected suffix-product envelope. Linearity and the triangle inequality then give the absolute bias bound; division by the nonzero exact sum yields equation (4.6).
informal_statement: Theorem 4.1 in full: the relative bias of the SR_(p,r) recursive sum is bounded by kappa(a) gamma_(n-1)(u_(p+r)). Lean writes n=m+1.
paper_version: published journal version; SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing 47(5), 2025, pages B1227-B1249

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: The frozen library supplies the exact recursive-fold expansion, finite-expectation algebra, and complete componentwise summation-condition reduction. It does not supply P17's limited-precision conditional-product envelope, which must be derived from the run certificate.
